stance.description: agree — the proposal is sound as it stands. disagree — at least one objection remains. needs_info — cannot judge until the open questions are answered.

stop.description: True only when there is nothing further worth discussing.

summary.description: Two or three sentences a human can act on.

findings.description: One entry per objection. Carry ids across rounds.

id.description: Stable across rounds, e.g. f1, f2.

evidence.description: What supports the claim. No evidence, no finding.

response.description: new — raised this round. confirm — the other side was right. dispute — rejected, with rationale. retract — withdrawn.

rationale.description: Required for dispute; a bare disagreement does not count.
